decisions.decision: DPW to keep following up with the contractor (Surfside) on the delayed Marshall Park 90' diamond backstop netting installation; play stays limited and batting uses the cage in the meantime.

decisions.decision: Mr. Ruth (Lunenburg Phillies) was advised to fill out the field usage request form; if a flat per season rate is adopted, the amount already paid this season will be applied to that rate.
